**Revenue Growth**  
NVIDIA is experiencing extraordinary revenue growth, with revenue increasing from $26.9B in 2022 to a projected $249.9B by 2027—a CAGR of 68.3%. The company’s year-over-year revenue growth peaked at 126% in 2024 and 114% in 2025, then moderates to single digits thereafter.

**Gross Profit Margin**  
Gross profit margin (represented as Contribution Margin) has improved significantly, recovering from a dip to 56.9% in 2023 to above 70% from 2024 onward, reflecting strong pricing power and operational leverage as revenues scale.

**SG&A Expense Margin**  
SG&A expense as a percentage of revenue is declining rapidly, from 8-9% in 2022-2023 to below 1% by 2027E, indicating substantial operating leverage and disciplined cost control relative to revenue growth.

**EBITDA Margin**  
EBITDA margin has expanded dramatically from 22.2% in 2023 to an estimated 73.5% in 2027, far outpacing peers and signaling exceptional profitability and efficiency gains as NVIDIA’s business scales.
